newsitem.title: USA: Saba says '96 oil reserves up to 31 mln bbl.
newsitem.headline: Saba says '96 oil reserves up to 31 mln bbl.

text.p: SANTA BARBARA, Calif., Feb. 20 - Saba said Thursday its total proved reserves rose to 31 million barrels oil equivalent (BOE) in 1996, due to increases in recoverable reserves, development of existing fields, and higher prices.
The 31 million (BOE) represented 194 percent of 1995 proved reserves, which stood at 16 million (BOE).
Total proved, probable and possible reserves were 135 million barrels, the company said in a written statement.
The company's oil and gas reserves are located primarily in California and Colombia.
